presets.name: Just like you
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: She follows your voice exactly: your rhythm, your ups and downs. Good for talking.

presets.name: Pop singer
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: What you say becomes a tune in a major key, with a light vibrato and a doubled voice.

presets.name: Robot
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Flat, even notes with no bends, no vibrato and a gap between words. A machine reading aloud.

presets.name: Diva
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: A wide, dramatic melody in a minor key, a deep slow vibrato, and a last note held long.

presets.name: Cover song
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: For singing a real song over its music: she keeps the notes and the timing you sing, with a little vibrato on long notes.

presets.name: Lullaby
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: Soft and slow: a gentle five-note melody, a faint vibrato, long last notes and a single voice.

presets.name: Choir
presets.author: Teto Relay
presets.description: A big, layered sound in a major key: the doubled voice turned all the way up.
